objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed artifact (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation with consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid the document belongs to.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking revisions of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Applicable scope or area of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational units for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period the document is retained after invalidation before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Period for validity extension check cycle (default 3 years).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-controlled information object added to a document, not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Formal proposal to amend an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (open, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring review of continued validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation, triggering the out-of-force and archiving process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring it to active use.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who participates in document lifecycle activities in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign collective authorizations and distribution membership.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group (reader, author, reviewer, releaser, archive, business admin).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that orchestrates approval steps (creator, review, release) with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow instance.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document that controls email notification and acknowledgement distribution upon release.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new document objects.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature recorded by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who signed.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step in which the signature was provided.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific view presenting document lists, status reports and evaluation information to users.

attributes.name: dashboard_type
attributes.description: Type of dashboard (reader, author, status report, acknowledgement report).

objs.name: client
objs.description: Tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system where document visibility and local extensions are managed.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template chosen for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator step as the first step of the release workflow using electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness within the review workflow step.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Whether the review is technical, formal, or both.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, cancelling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions or attachment changes occur.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the resolution of a change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (or full release chain) confirms the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The override process concludes, setting the document status to out of force and revoking authorizations.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments are archived, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: delete_archived_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, documents are physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A business admin group member creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is restored to active status with a new version, retaining prior metadata and properties.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: A non-controlled additional information object is added to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual users for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read, write).

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document version.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a document via workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is reviewed and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding language.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with an invalidated document are reactivated together with the main document.
